canonical_name: TOO GOOD TO GO NORGE AS
circular_mechanism: app marketplace for surplus food from shops cafes restaurants and similar actors
weakest_point: Norwegian legal entity is mainly marketing/recruitment for the app; saved-meal or climate-effect KPIs need separate primary KPI source
ikke_si: Do not use global saved-meal figures or app impact numbers as Norway-specific realized food-waste reduction without source.

circular_mechanism: resale of surplus goods and goods with short or poor shelf life through stores and online retail
weakest_point: Official page and Brreg verify model and identity; exact avoided-waste tonnage and supplier mix need separate KPI source
ikke_si: Do not treat resale volume or revenue as measured food-waste reduction without a KPI or annual-report source.

circular_mechanism: national food-bank network redistributing surplus food from food industry to non-profit organizations
weakest_point: 2024 redistributed-tonnage source exists but should be kept as network output not proof of total national food-waste prevention
ikke_si: Do not present Matsentralen tonnes as total Norwegian saved food or as complete redistribution coverage.

circular_mechanism: coordination knowledge and industry-agreement work for food-waste reduction across the value chain
weakest_point: Matvett is a coordination and knowledge actor, not a producer retailer or waste handler
ikke_si: Do not make Matvett a direct food-waste handler or producer. Keep effect claims tied to agreement/report sources.

circular_mechanism: order-driven online grocery model and food-waste management with reported waste as share of revenue
weakest_point: Oda's own waste metric is useful but needs preserved denominator and date/context before comparison with sector averages
ikke_si: Do not compare Oda's percentage to other actors without matching metric definitions and reporting year.

circular_mechanism: software for inventory control expiry-date alerts food-waste reporting and waste prevention
weakest_point: Actor-primary impact percentages are marketing claims and need customer/source separation before KPI import
ikke_si: Do not use vendor-reported percentage reductions as independent evidence of national food-waste impact.

circular_mechanism: discount retail of surplus lots date goods packaging deviations and food and drink categories
weakest_point: Food-waste mechanism is visible on retailer site but exact supplier streams and avoided-waste quantities are not verified
ikke_si: Do not call all Havaristen inventory saved food waste; some lots may be non-food or general surplus goods.

circular_mechanism: Matvett-led collaboration with serving/canteen sector to reduce food waste under the industry agreement
weakest_point: Project/program row only; participant-level effects and company rows need separate source handling
ikke_si: Do not count a collaboration program as a direct actor output or participant compliance proof.

aliases: Agreement to reduce food waste in Norway
circular_mechanism: voluntary agreement between authorities and private actors to halve food waste by 2030
weakest_point: Agreement row supports ecosystem context only; it is not a company, network output or proof of individual actor performance
ikke_si: Do not convert the 2030 goal into achieved reduction or actor-level compliance evidence.

aliases: Norsk institutt for baerekraftsforskning AS; Ostfoldforskning
circular_mechanism: food-waste research mapping causes quantities and measures across the value chain
weakest_point: Research row verifies knowledge role only; project-level findings must be cited separately
ikke_si: Do not treat research institute rows as producer, retailer or waste-handler coverage.
